motivation_quotes: STRENGTH DOES NOT COME FROM WINNING. YOUR STRUGGLES DEVELOP YOUR STRENGTHS.
DON'T STOP WHEN YOU'RE TIRED. STOP WHEN YOU'RE DONE.
SUCCESS IS THE SUM OF SMALL EFFORTS, REPEATED DAY IN AND DAY OUT.
WHETHER YOU THINK YOU CAN OR YOU THINK YOU CAN'T, YOU'RE RIGHT.
PAIN IS TEMPORARY. PRIDE IS FOREVER.
DISCIPLINE IS THE BRIDGE BETWEEN GOALS AND ACCOMPLISHMENT.
THE ONLY BAD WORKOUT IS THE ONE THAT DIDN'T HAPPEN.
DON'T WAIT FOR THE RIGHT MOMENT. CREATE IT.
YOUR BODY CAN DO ANYTHING. IT'S YOUR MIND YOU HAVE TO CONVINCE.
THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE IMPOSSIBLE AND THE POSSIBLE LIES IN DETERMINATION.
EVERY DAY IS A NEW OPPORTUNITY TO BECOME STRONGER.
I DON'T KNOW ANYONE WHO HAS GOTTEN TO THE TOP WITHOUT HARD WORK.
